case_title: Prem Singh v. State of NCT of Delhi
aggravating_circumstances: Strangulation of children, disposal of bodies, false narrative
trial_court_outcome: Guilty under s.302 and s.201 IPC, life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, Prem Singh, took his two sons, aged approximately 9 and 6 years, to a canal, where he strangulated them and disposed of their bodies in the water. The accused then attempted to fabricate a narrative of accidental drowning. The prosecution presented circumstantial evidence, including witness accounts and medical reports, establishing the cause of death as manual strangulation. The accused's actions, including the disposal of the bodies and the false narrative, were central to the prosecution's case. The trial court convicted the accused of murder under Section 302 of the IPC, and the High Court upheld this conviction.
